# See What You Made Me Do companion — build notes (2026-11-18)

Book slug: `see-what-you-made-me-do` (companion to Jess Hill, *See What You Made Me Do*, revised UK edn, Hurst 2020).

- 13 chapters, 47 sections, 505 questions. Chapters 1–10 follow the book; Notes on Methods and the Introduction are folded into the first two sections of Chapter 1 so chapter numbers match. Chapter 11 is the Dadirri appendix, 12 records law reform and corrections since 2020 (web-verified), 13 is a cross-chapter review with applied scenarios.
- The first section has a content warning and helpline numbers, and notes that quiz progress is stored in the browser.
- Every quoted passage (in “ ”) was checked automatically against the PDF text and page; all matched. Page numbers = PDF page minus 14.
- Corrections flagged in the text: DSM-IV was 1994 (book says 2000); the Scottish maximum is 14 years (book says 15); Challen sequence (retrial ordered Feb 2019, manslaughter plea June 2019); Ireland criminalised coercive control from Jan 2019.
- README Library table: one new row after `introduction-to-criminological-theory`. Delivered as a tar.gz of README.md plus content/books/see-what-you-made-me-do/. No files deleted.
